name: Evil Engine
description: Our own game engine SDK in C#: numbered class libraries over Godot 4.7.2 for a full 3D game (camera, lights, world objects, screen); 0.1.0 was the OpenTK 2D engine.

prod.notes: Packages go to the folder feed /mnt/hdd/projects/MyGameFrameWork-data/feed; games pin the exact version.

dev.notes: Runs the demo in Godot 4.7.2 under xvfb on the server (no port); on a desktop open samples/OrbitDemo in Godot and press play.

check.notes: Build with warnings as errors, the pure test runner, the OrbitDemo in Godot under xvfb with a captured frame in documents/screenshots.

flow.promote: scripts/check.sh green, bump the version in Directory.Build.props, commit, ./scripts/pack.sh, push; games move to the exact version.
rules: Lock-step versions: every package carries the same version.
Packages only from the checked list; Godot pinned at 4.7.2.
The engine reads no config and no environment variable: games pass values to GameBuilder.
Godot types never appear in the public API.
